title: Artesunate-binding FABP5 promotes apoptosis in lung cancer cells via the PPARgamma-SCD pathway.
authors: Wang, Qingsen; Zhou, Jiawei; Cheng, Anqi; Liu, Yafeng; Guo, Jianqiang; Li, Xuan; Chen, Maoqian; Hu, Dong; Wu, Jing
one_liner_zh: 该文研究青蒿素结合FABP5蛋白并通过PPARgamma-SCD通路促进肺癌细胞凋亡，虽涉及分子对接和转录因子PPARgamma，但核心是药物-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法用于TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Artesunate holds excellent promise for lung cancer treatment, but its target is still unclear. We used molecular docking techniques to predict artesunate and Fatty acid binding protein 5 (FABP5) binding sites. Cellular thermal shift assay (CETSA) verified that artesunate treatment could promote the stability of the FABP5 protein. There was no significant change in the strength of the FABP5 protein after the mutation of binding sites by adding artesunate treatment. Mechanistically, artesunate promotes apoptosis in lung cancer cells by binding to FABP5, inhibiting the expression of the lipid metabolism gene SCD, and suppressing the expression of the SCD transcription factor regulated by the transcription factor PPARgamma. In summary, our study shows that the protein targeted by artesunate is FABP5 and that artesunate promotes apoptosis through the FABP5-PPARgamma-SCD pathway, which offers excellent potential for treating lung cancer.
abstract_zh: 青蒿琥酯在肺癌治疗中展现出巨大潜力，但其靶点尚不明确。我们采用分子对接技术预测了青蒿琥酯与脂肪酸结合蛋白5（FABP5）的结合位点。细胞热位移分析（CETSA）验证了青蒿琥酯处理能促进FABP5蛋白的稳定性。在结合位点突变后，添加青蒿琥酯处理未观察到FABP5蛋白强度的显著变化。机制上，青蒿琥酯通过结合FABP5，抑制脂质代谢基因SCD的表达，并抑制由转录因子PPARgamma调控的SCD转录因子表达，从而促进肺癌细胞凋亡。总之，我们的研究表明青蒿琥酯的靶向蛋白为FABP5，且青蒿琥酯通过FABP5-PPARgamma-SCD通路促进凋亡，这为肺癌治疗提供了巨大潜力。
